title: A failed chat-list read is not retried until the page reloads or an erase is shown
evidence: Done 2026-11-13 (US-15 AC64a): List gains failed; list-landed null goes there and keeps the old titles; list-wanted reads from failed as from unread, so the next open of the chat (the Chat tab or the embed coming into view) reads again. listConversations moves the store open inside its try, so a throw answers null. No timer (design: docs/drafts/c22-c26-design.md). Was: A list read can fail in two ways, and neither is retried. (a) listConversations returns null: listLanded moves the list to read and keeps the old list (packages/health-core/src/chat-turn.ts:244), so the next list-wanted reads nothing. (b) It throws: cloudHistory() and store.listConversations() sit outside the try (widget-src/src/lib/chat-api.ts:224-226), so readList (widget-src/src/hooks/useChatState.ts:176-178) never dispatches list-landed; the list stays reading, and the rejection reaches loadConversationsIfNeeded's callers uncaught (widget-src/src/components/ChatSection.tsx:85,97; widget-src/src/components/ChatEmbed.tsx:53). Main behaved the same before slice 3. Path (a) is pinned in useChatState.slice3-pins.test.tsx (US-15 C26); path (b) is not. The owner ruled the fix out of chat-turn slice 3 (2026-11-12).
